recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5503; future UDI work should target the current Device.udiCarrier and DeviceDefinition model rather than restoring old Device.udi or full-UDI-in-Device.type wording.
issue_request: FHIR-5503 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request from the January 2015 DSTU1 ballot. It asked the Device type notes to mention local UDI repositories/GUDID as possible code sources while clarifying that the full UDI string belongs in the dedicated Device UDI element rather than Device.type.
initial_application: Commit 85cad2a017a228c70b358dab887c56b5bfccb18e pre-applied FHIR-5503 together with FHIR-5849, FHIR-5505, FHIR-5506, and part of FHIR-5504 before the 2015-03-26 OO block vote. That commit replaced the proposed full-UDI-in-Device.type wording with text pointing full UDI strings at Device.udi and revised the related UDI notes.
additional_context: Device is active in the current build. Several originally related artifacts are retired or redirected, including DeviceComponent, DeviceObservationReport, DeviceUseRequest, and DeviceUseStatement. Later final decisions and combined-branch reconciliations superseded the old Device.udi string with the current Device.udiCarrier model, audited the local-repository/GUDID wording, and reconciled later Device.type/GMDN binding changes.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current Device notes list standard type-code sources such as SNOMED CT, GMDN, and RTM, while the UDI section and Device.udiCarrier definitions represent the full UDI carrier through AIDC/HRF elements and mapping guidance.
